manifest.description_for_human: Prepares an Azure deployment confirmation card for an intentionally invalid Bicep debug sample.

subscription_id.description: Azure subscription ID where the sample deployment should run.

deployment_label.description: Short label for the debug deployment.

reasoning.description: Use when the user asks to prepare a Bicep deployment confirmation card for invalid Bicep. Deployment side effects happen only after confirmation.
examples: Prepare the invalid Bicep debug deployment confirmation card for my subscription in eastus
